newsitem.title: USA: Southern Peru Copper Q3 production up.
newsitem.headline: Southern Peru Copper Q3 production up.

text.p: Southern Peru Copper Corp Thursday reported third quarter copper mine production of 169.9 million pounds, saying this was up 23 percent from 1995's September quarter.

Reporting earnings of $37.9 million for the latest quarter, down from $62.1 million in 1995's third quarter, the company said the $0.47 per pound drop in copper prices over the past year, to $0.90 received in the third quarter, reduced net earnings by $42.8 million.
Southern Peru said third quarter profits included a pretax gain of $4.4 million on the sale or exercise of copper put options covering 34,000 tons of copper.
It said pretax gains of $8.8 million will be recognized in the next two quarters for options already sold as the underlying production is sold.

The company said the increase in third quarter production is principally attributable to higher ore grades at the Cuajone mine and 24.4 million pounds of refined copper produced from the the new solvent extraction/electrowinning plant at its Toquepala mine which began operations in 1995's final quarter.
While sales volumes were comparable, Southern Peru said, cost of sales declined to $99.9 million in the third quarter from $130.4 million a year earlier.

It said the decline was principally attributable to the reduction of sales of copper produced from purchased concentrates which were replaced by sales of copper from the company's new SX/EW operation. -- Jim Brumm 212-859-1710.
